Raise HOST_MESH_STASH in framework/gpu/3d.zig.
[r3d] host mesh stash FULL (16) — a dropped model was DROPPED and will not draw. Raise HOST_MESH_STASH in framework/gpu/3d.zig.
resolution: Fixed the 'host mesh stash FULL (16) — DROPPED and will not draw' error that appeared when scrubbing the quality slider. Cause: each quality level stashes its decimated mesh under a new key (path#qN); dragging the slider stashed many levels that were superseded before they ever drew, so internFromStash never freed their slots and after 16 distinct un-drawn keys the stash filled and the model vanished. Fix: the viewer shows ONE host mesh at a time, so stashHostMesh now evicts every other (obsolete) stash entry as it stashes the new current one, bounding the stash to 1 pending mesh — scrubbing can't fill it. Also quantized the quality slider to 20 discrete levels so revisiting a level reuses its already-resident mesh instead of interning an unbounded number of distinct meshes into the retained GPU buffer. Verified: RJIT_QUALITYSTRESS scrubs 30 distinct levels (well past 16) and the model still draws with no stash-full error. Separately answered the user's paint-transfer question (paint currently resets on quality change; carrying it across LODs is a real follow-on = the LoD paint-bake).
